versions.content: For each configured Time Master ( FrTSynGlobalTimeMas- ter ) the FrTSyn module shall periodically transmit OFS messages with the cycle FrTSynGlobalTimeTxPeriod ) including the Offset Time value and User Data, if the GLOBAL_TIME_BASE bit within the timeBaseStatus is set and FrTSynGlobal- TimeTxPeriod is unequal to 0 and if the associated cyclicMsgResumeCounter is not running. The cyclic transmission shall be started in the earliest possible FrTSyn_MainFunc- tion call once the requirements above are fulfilled.
